documentation.version_note: Context7 returned main-branch references rather than exact installed-version snapshots. Nest examples included Vitest; implementation uses installed Jest 30 APIs, checked in local typings. TypeORM PostgresDriver installExtensions and PostgresConnectionOptions were cross-checked locally.

full_tests.command: docker compose exec -T nestjs-api npm test -- --runInBand

e2e.command: docker compose exec -T nestjs-api npm run test:e2e -- --runInBand

discovery.command: docker compose exec -T nestjs-api npm test -- --listTests --runInBand

typescript.command: docker compose exec -T nestjs-api npx tsc --noEmit

global_lint.command: docker compose exec -T nestjs-api npm run lint -- --no-fix
global_lint.note: Existing findings in 10 unchanged files; quality gate remains pending SI-03.1.2 and SI-03.1.3. --no-fix avoids modifying their scope.

database.test_database_environment: TEST_DB_NAME (defaults to DB_NAME + _test); TEST_PROTECTED_DB_NAME captured from application DB_NAME by globalSetup; setupFiles redirects DB_NAME for AppModule/E2E. Host defaults to Compose db.
database.safety: Helpers reject database names without safe *_test suffix, names over 63 bytes, and the protected application database before DDL/cleanup. Cleanup follows token/channel/user FK order. synchronize:false; explicit entity and migration classes.
database.migration_isolation: Unique migrations_<uuid>_test database with exclusive public schema. Needed because the immutable auth-token migration qualifies public. Ordered rollback and finally restoration; private database dropped after connections close.
database.dump_normalization: pg_dump --no-owner --no-privileges with comment and backslash directive lines removed; hash only, no development data included.

notes: No existing migrations, runtime domain logic, or production data modified.
Full suites run after scoped delegated tests to satisfy explicit root AGENTS.md verification requirement.
